channel.title: Middle East AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Israel/Gaza, Iran, Syria, Lebanon and Iraq developments

item.title: CENTEF report reveals Hezbollah acquired $157m of weapons in 2024, majority provided freely by Iran
item.description: The report, titled Hezbollah Financial Statements, is the first installment in a series set to expose Hezbollah's spending on media, payments to wounded fighters, and its military infrastructure.

item.title: Ben-Gvir to demand extradition of flydubai pilot to Israel after attempted terror hijacking
item.description: "Our security doctrine must be clear: Anyone who tries to murder or harm Israelis, the State of Israel will pursue them and settle the score with them anywhere in the world," he said.

item.title: UNICEF warns of severe child deprivation in Lebanon as displacement, economic tolls mount
item.description: “Without urgent and sustained action, an entire generation of children and young people risks carrying the scars of this crisis into adulthood,” UNICEF Lebanon Representative Marcoluigi Corsi said.

item.title: IDF gives rejection of 'NAZA' film claims, disputes civilian death ratios, AI targeting abuse
item.description: According to the IDF, the intelligence interviewees were not experts, but rather a middle step of the targeting process, who knew much less about the final step.

item.title: Syria, Hezbollah hold secret security talks in Turkey, reportedly to ease border tensions
item.description: One of the Syrian officials said both sides agreed they held no hostility towards one another, and that Syria assured Hezbollah that it would not intervene militarily in Lebanon to disarm the group.

item.title: Netanyahu says Israel warned Britain about Iranian terror plot before RAF airbase incident
item.description: Netanyahu also discussed the recent attempted hijacking of a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv, praising the heroism of Yaniv Hayoun in "preventing another 9/11."

item.title: Saudi Arabia was reluctant to fully cooperate with Israel during attempted flydubai hijacking
item.description: Although the Saudis went to great lengths to receive and assist the Israeli passengers aboard the flydubai flight, they did not fully cooperate with Israel.

item.title: UAE, Israel open investigation into flydubai hijacking attempt, seek to confirm terror motive
item.description: The investigation looks to establish whether or not the hijacking was motivated by terrorism.

item.title: Who will teach the next generation?
item.description: A Jerusalem summit will bring together more than 300 educators from Israel and around the world to share ideas, confront common challenges, and strengthen the connections that sustain Jewish life.

item.title: No. 1: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump: Remembering who brought the hostages home
item.description: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump helped achieve what few in Jerusalem thought possible, bringing every Israeli hostage home and reshaping the Middle East.

item.title: No. 3: Gadi Eisenkot: Israel’s next prime minister?
item.description: The former IDF chief has emerged as the leading opposition challenger to Netanyahu, offering voters a path to a post-Netanyahu Israel.

item.title: No. 4: Naftali Bennett: The former PM seeking a comeback to ‘repair Israel’
item.description: Since returning to politics, Bennett has shifted from his previous campaigns, taking a more liberal position while maintaining a strong right-wing stance on security.

item.title: No. 5: Ronald Lauder: Standing at the forefront of the fight against antisemitism
item.description: Lauder has never confined himself to quiet philanthropy - he continues to use his position to demand accountability from political leaders.

item.title: No. 2: Benjamin Netanyahu: Shaping Israel’s politics and global image for a generation
item.description: Netanyahu has become more than Israel’s prime minister for many. Abroad, for instance, he has become Israel’s symbol and the lightning rod for much of the hatred directed against the Jewish state.

item.title: High Court panel hears appeals against Central Elections Committee bans on Arab Knesset slates
item.description: The court is hearing these cases after the Central Elections Committee voted earlier this month to disqualify them from the election run, and all petitioned against it.

item.title: Israeli man, 26, drowns in Norway after falling from boat, Foreign Ministry says
item.description: The Israeli Embassy in Oslo and the Foreign Ministry’s department for Israelis in distress abroad have been handling the case with local authorities since receiving the report.

item.title: Flydubai pilot attempts terror hijacking of flight to Tel Aviv, foiled by Israeli passengers
item.description: Israeli official says “major disaster avoided” after pilot stabbed his co-pilot, attempted to hijack aircraft with over 100 Israeli passengers • Plane makes emergency landing in Saudi Arabia

item.title: Two Israelis arrested in Cyprus after over 27 kg. of ketamine, other drugs found in apartment
item.description: A court on Thursday morning ordered that the two be remanded for eight days for investigative purposes. Their defense attorneys did not object to the police request.

item.title: High Court clears publication of identity of Gaza Division intelligence officer on Oct. 7
item.description: Lt.-Col. Amidror is considered to have firmly rejected the possibility that Hamas would carry out its raid scenario, known as the "Jericho Wall" plan.

item.title: Why four pilots were aboard flydubai flight when the attempted hijacking began - exclusive
item.description: The additional pilots were added to the flight because possible regional rerouting could extend the journey and push the original crew beyond permitted duty hours.
